verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms funnel-building and segmentation ('Build funnels, segment users, answer why') which implies path-oriented analysis, and session replay lets PMs see individual user journeys, but there is no explicit mention of a dedicated path-exploration/Pathfinder feature showing aggregate paths before/after a key event. Missing for 10: explicit path-analysis feature documentation, aggregate multi-step path visualization, evidence of forward/backward path exploration around a chosen event.
